site_name: Amazon (AWS) Quail Ridge campus, 24214 Quail Ridge Ln, Aldie, VA 20105
year_evidence_quote: Neither data center is operating yet, but their presence is inescapable.
year_site_match: The article names no street address. It describes a 1-million-square-foot Amazon Web Services data center across Quail Ridge Lake from Loudoun Meadows, near Aldie in southeastern Loudoun County, with a Microsoft data center on the other side. The Dgtl Infra page I opened places AWS's Quail Ridge site at 24214 and 24244 Quail Ridge Lane, Aldie, with 992.3k sq ft of approved data-center floor area, adjacent to a Microsoft-owned parcel (IAD 11, 41840 Growth Mindset Lane, Aldie). Name, town, operator, size and the Microsoft neighbor all agree; the tie to the street address is inference from those matches, not a statement on the news page.
verification: Supported, with caveats. The Richmond Times-Dispatch article (credited on the solwd.net repost, distributed by Tribune Content Agency, post dated 2025-12-01) says neither the Amazon nor the Microsoft data center by Loudoun Meadows is operating yet; the solwd.net copy also carries a second passage saying the two data centers next to Loudoun Meadows will not begin to operate until next year (forward-looking, not a start year). The same quote appears on the smarterdigitalvirginia.com repost dated Dec 1, 2025. Caveats: (1) I could not open the original; richmond.com and pilotonline.com both refused automated fetch, so the evidence is two reposts of the syndicated text. (2) The address match is inference (see site_match), which is why confidence is medium rather than high. (3) Unresolved tension worth a human look: Dgtl Infra (undated page, apparently about May 2022, date is my inference from context) says two powered shells, Buildings A and B totaling 412.4k sq ft, were already constructed at the site when AWS bought it on 2021-12-30. Built shells are not the same as operating, and no page I opened says they are operating, but the news article's 'not operating yet' rests on a reporter's description rather than an operator or government record. Quotes were returned through the fetch tool's extraction model in fragments; the deciding sentence came back identical from both reposts.

lead.notes: A Richmond Times-Dispatch article dated 2025-12-01 (republished on solwd.net and smarterdigitalvirginia.com) describes a 1-million-sq-ft AWS complex overlooking Quail Ridge Lake by Loudoun Meadows near Aldie. It says 'Neither data center is operating yet.' I tie it to this address by the Quail Ridge name, the Aldie location, and size: DGTL Infra reports roughly 992k sq ft of buildable data-center GFA at 24214/24244 Quail Ridge Ln. The article names no street, so the match is inference, and the status is medium-confidence.
